info.title: Wishboard REST API
info.description: Interactive OpenAPI reference for the Wishboard event matchmaking platform. Provides endpoints for wish submissions, identity matching, Wishmail messaging, admin moderation, and runtime configuration.

BearerAuth.description: Session token obtained from POST /api/users/login (stored in session database).

PassphraseAuth.description: Three-word local passphrase used to manage created wishes and wishmail.
